Y's one verified insight X lacks (the `*)` arm is unreachable because the else-branch hard-codes rc 1 at :13365) does not offset four ungrounded or missing key items. Neither has a bad citation. X vs Z — tie: each holds a verified, material fact the other lacks. X has cloud-retire-terminal (K9, a whole discharge path Z's summary denies by saying 'three automated paths') and a code-grounded deathwatch verdict; Z has the full cross-file citation audit the brief demanded (11 rows, all confirmed), plus a real verified defect X missed (the :8707 discharge precedes both the SC_DRY exit at :8709 and the M3 exit 6 at :8754). Each carries one hedged wrong claim: X's 'exactly one opener found' (cc-offload:747, cc-dispatch:904/932 exist) and Z's defect 4 (cloud slugs are `cloud-<sid>`, so the drain token `cloud/<id>` cannot match). No bad citations on either side. Y vs Z — Z: Z verifies self-close (:8657/:8707, gate list, --successor bypass), cloud-return's landed_ok condition (:977-982), operator-readout (:915/:929/:940), and the complete stale-citation set including the three mailbox-drain rows Y explicitly could not check; Z also surfaces the verified dry-run/M3 discharge defect.
